mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "BOARD" WHERE BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' AND CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode}

SELECT BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, MEMBER_NICKNAME, BOARD_VIEW_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "COMMENT" C WHERE C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) COMMENT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "BOARD_LIKE" L WHERE L.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) LIKE_COUNT,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - B.BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전' WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - B.BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전' WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - B.BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전' ELSE TO_CHAR(B.BOARD_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END BOARD_WRITE_DATE
FROM "BOARD" B JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) WHERE BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' AND CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode} ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "BOARD" JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) WHERE BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' AND CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode}
AND BOARD_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} ||'%' AND BOARD_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{query} ||'%' AND (BOARD_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{query} ||'%' OR BOARD_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} ||'%') AND MEMBER_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} ||'%'

SELECT BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, MEMBER_NICKNAME, BOARD_VIEW_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "COMMENT" C WHERE C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) COMMENT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "BOARD_LIKE" L WHERE L.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) LIKE_COUNT,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - B.BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전' WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - B.BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전' WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - B.BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전' ELSE TO_CHAR(B.BOARD_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END BOARD_WRITE_DATE
FROM "BOARD" B JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) WHERE BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' AND CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode}
AND BOARD_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} ||'%' AND BOARD_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{query} ||'%' AND (BOARD_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{query} ||'%' OR BOARD_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} ||'%') AND MEMBER_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} ||'%'
ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_VIEW_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "BOARD_LIKE" L WHERE L.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) LIKE_COUNT FROM "BOARD" B WHERE BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' AND CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode} ORDER BY LIKE_COUNT DESC, BOARD_VIEW_COUNT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, TO_CHAR(BOARD_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BOARD_WRITE_DATE FROM "BOARD" WHERE BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' AND BOARD_CODE = #{noticeBoardCode} ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
